funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage with a confirmed publisher and scheduled publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for authors to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles related to British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage; tiered amounts based on career level; open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals to undertake research travel and/or research time in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in or starting a master's or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Provides a fixed £5,000 to support students beginning or continuing postgraduate study in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered undergraduate or higher students researching eighteenth- or nineteenth‑century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel to examine historical works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) for research.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer to start a UK‑based master's degree in British art between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding for a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer to start a UK‑based doctorate in British art between April 2027 and April 2028; open to international applicants (fees‑only amount).
opportunities.summary: Provides £32,000 per year for three years to cover tuition and living costs for a doctoral programme.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Post‑doctoral level individuals (or equivalent experience) seeking to undertake a major research project.
opportunities.summary: Supports a one‑ or two‑year research project in British art with £35k per year.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals (pre‑doctoral to senior) with a first degree, interested in British‑Italian cultural exchange.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome with board, accommodation and honorarium.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Autumn 2026 round of funding opportunities

amount.raw: up to £40,000 for organisations; up to £6,000 for individuals; up to £6,000 for organisations publications; up to £5,000 for digitisation; up to £3,000 for events; up to £25,000 for conservation

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Various eligibility criteria per grant type; generally UK‑based organisations or individuals working in British art, visual culture or architectural history.
opportunities.summary: A suite of grants for the Autumn 2026 round, including a new £40k research grant for organisations and several £3k‑£25k grants for publications, digitisation, events, and conservation.
